caption:
A water dragon meets living lightning.
Seedance 2.0 made this anime duel from text.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: high-end Japanese anime feature-film quality: 2D cel-shaded characters with clean line art composited into painterly, near-photoreal backgrounds, with glossy 3D water and lightning effects, heavy bloom and particles. Moonlit misty forest at night, deep teal-blue shadows, cold moonlight; the water glows cyan-blue, the lightning burns gold-white. Camera feel: slow, heavy push-ins and orbits for the stances, then extreme-speed low tracking shots, whip pans and impact smash cuts with white flash frames. Pacing: 6 seconds of charged build-up, 1.5 seconds of stillness, then 7.5 seconds of frantic flash cuts ending in a blinding explosion. No gore, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WATER SWORDSMAN: a teenage boy (about 16), slim and athletic, light skin, short tousled jet-black hair with one silver streak falling over his forehead, steel-grey eyes, determined frown. Deep indigo short haori with thin white wave lines over a dark charcoal high-collared uniform, wide dark trousers gathered into white shin wraps, dark straw sandals. Katana with a round silver guard and a pale steel blade. Signature: the silver streak and the indigo wave-line haori.
- THE LIGHTNING SWORDSMAN: a teenage boy (about 16), lean, light skin, chin-length messy silver-white hair hanging over his eyes, sharp amber eyes. Long crimson-red haori with a black zigzag stripe along the hem and sleeves over a black high-collared uniform, white shin wraps, black sandals. Katana with a black scabbard at his left hip and a gold cord. Signature: the crimson haori with the black zigzag hem and the silver-white hair.

LOCATION: a dense forest of tall dark pine and cedar trunks at night, thick ground mist, a full moon behind drifting clouds, dark muddy ground covered in fallen brown leaves.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.3) — The stance. Full-body low-angle shot: the water swordsman in a deep crouch on the forest path, gripping his katana with both hands, blade raised diagonally up to the right, the full moon glowing top left behind clouds, mist drifting. Slow push-in with a gentle orbit to the right; he exhales, turns the blade upright and shifts his feet; at 00:02.0 water starts to spray and splash around his feet.

SHOT 2 (00:02.3-00:06.0) — The water dragon. MUST SHOW: a giant translucent cyan-blue dragon made entirely of rushing high-pressure water, with a scaled body, a horned head and open jaws with water fangs. 00:02.3-00:03.0: the dragon's roaring head bursts out of his blade and sweeps past the lens, filling the frame. 00:03.0-00:06.0: the camera pulls back to a low wide angle: the dragon's long body whips around him horizontally just above the ground, then rises, arches over his head and wraps around him in two huge spiraling rings, throwing spray and lighting the dark forest blue; he holds a low crouch in the center, blade held horizontally, muddy water splashing at his feet.

SHOT 3 (00:06.0-00:07.7) — The opponent. Hard cut to darkness and stillness: an extreme wide shot of the dark forest, the lightning swordsman small in the center, crouched extremely low in a sword-drawing stance. Slow push-in to a full shot by 00:07.0: knees wide, head bowed with silver-white hair hiding his eyes, one hand on the hilt, the long blade angled down to the ground on the left.

SHOT 4 (00:07.7-00:08.4) — Ignition. MUST SHOW: a massive golden lightning bolt striking down onto him from the sky; the ground explodes, dirt, leaves and dust blasting outward, gold light flaring across the tree trunks, white flash frames.

SHOT 5 (00:08.4-00:09.0) — Dash. Low tracking shot skimming the ground: he streaks left to right, bent almost horizontal, leaving a blinding gold-white lightning trail, motion blur on the ground.

SHOT 6 (00:09.0-00:09.5) — Zig. He cuts back right to left, crouched low, a golden arc tearing the ground behind him.

SHOT 7 (00:09.5-00:10.0) — Zag. Another sharp turn, a crackling gold bolt zigzagging between the trees behind him, scorched leaves flying.

SHOT 8 (00:10.0-00:10.5) — Skid. Low wide angle: he skids sideways on one knee as jagged lightning branches across the frame and along the ground.

SHOT 9 (00:10.5-00:11.2) — Past the lens. He blurs toward and past the camera; his crimson haori sweeps across the lens in a smear of gold light.

SHOT 10 (00:11.2-00:12.6) — Face to face. Wide: the lightning swordsman crouched in the left foreground with his blade drawn, gold sparks around him; the water swordsman leaping on the right inside a spiraling ring of water. The camera swings up to a high angle (00:12.0): the water swordsman spins in the lower-left foreground wrapped in a curling blue water dragon, the lightning swordsman across the clearing top right with a gold bolt crackling from his blade; both launch at each other.

SHOT 11 (00:12.6-00:12.9) — Collision. Close side view: a wall of blue water from the left and a golden lightning streak from the right slam together, the two blades crossing at the center in a burst of white light.

SHOT 12 (00:12.9-00:13.2) — Wide: the two clash small in the center of the dark forest, the water arc and the lightning meeting between the trunks.

SHOT 13 (00:13.2-00:14.0) — The blast. Medium shot, blades locked between them, the water swordsman on the left, the lightning swordsman on the right: blue water and gold lightning explode outward in radiating streaks of light, debris flying.

SHOT 14 (00:14.0-00:14.6) — Wide: a towering pillar of blue-white light erupts from the center of the forest into the sky, and a horizontal shockwave of gold lightning cuts through the tree trunks on both sides, snapping them.

SHOT 15 (00:14.6-00:15.1) — The shockwave rushes into the camera: churning blue-white water, light and debris fill the whole frame, ending in blinding blue and white.

SOUND: Epic cinematic score: low ominous strings and a slow taiko heartbeat in Shots 1-2, rising with a choir swell as the dragon appears; near-silence in Shot 3 (wind in the trees, one held breath); then fast pounding taiko and brass from Shot 4 to the end. Effects: a deep inhale, the ring of steel, the rushing roar of water and a dragon roar made of crashing waves, a thunder crack and ground explosion, sizzling electric crackle on every dash, a sharp blade clash, a huge booming impact, trees cracking, then a roaring whoosh that cuts to silence on the last frame. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Anime film look, moonlit misty forest. A black-haired swordsman in an indigo haori summons a giant water dragon that coils around him; a silver-haired swordsman in a crimson haori turns into golden lightning, zigzags through the trees; they clash in a blinding blast.
